title: What If the Week Had Ten Days? France Tried It
subject: French calendar

scenes.text: What if the week had ten days? France tried it, and workers hated it.
In 1793, revolutionary France scrapped the seven-day week for a ten-day cycle.
Each month had three of them, and the tenth day replaced Sunday as the day off.
So workers got one rest day in ten, instead of one in seven.
Clocks changed too: a day had ten hours, each with 100 minutes.
The experiment lasted about twelve years, until Napoleon abolished the calendar in 1805.
